build_lfd_builder: build an LfdBuilder instance wrapping an off-policy algorithm builder with demonstrations and config
create_demonstrations_factory: create a callable factory returning an infinite iterator of action and timestep demonstration pairs
make_adder_lfd: make an LfdAdder that mixes demonstrations with online experience using a configurable demonstration ratio
make_replay_tables: make replay tables by delegating to the underlying off-policy algorithm builder
make_actor: make an actor by delegating to the underlying off-policy algorithm builder
